formal_claim_rule: F1-F9 are bounded to the exact frozen Lean declarations and terminal Aristotle/Viridis audit receipt. No empirical or authority inference is permitted.

claims.claim: Biological robustness can involve stochasticity, heterogeneity, delay, incoherence, and apparent inefficiency.
Optimized systems can be robust to designed-for disturbances and fragile to unanticipated disturbances or design errors.
Robustness is represented as a declared relation over boundary, invariants, disturbances, horizon, scales, stakeholders, evidence, and authority.
Shared ancestry lowers declared finite-set dependency independence.
Execution is true exactly when selection and every frozen authority condition pass.
An explicitly asserted claim state does not by itself create a distinct claim state.
Recalled artifacts and declared descendants are blocked while unrelated artifacts are not blocked solely by that recall relation.
Closed-interval robust pass and fail are disjoint and the frozen classifier is complete and exact.
The frozen robust-dominance relation is irreflexive and transitive.
Frozen trajectory shortfall and marked violation span are nonnegative, and an everywhere nonnegative trace has zero shortfall.
The frozen aftershock count cannot exceed the number of adjacent sample pairs.
Formal proof, selection, authorization, deployment, and observation require distinct witnesses in the frozen state model.
The v0.6.0 reference suite passes 35 tests on two synthetic domain fixtures.

The service passes 5 focused tests, the isolated fleet passes 2136 tests across 37 agents, and the exact digest-bound image is deployed as a healthy internal-only non-actuating fleet service with an 8-second rollback drill.
The governed kernel may improve decision auditability and invariant preservation in real cross-domain decisions.

prohibited_inferences: local fleet adoption implies production deployment
technical readiness implies canon admission or publication
